---
title: Stuffed Fried Green Olives
id: MAR-0051
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 10
time_min: 80
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 0.5 kg large green olives
- 120 g minced beef
- 30 g cleaned chicken liver
- 20 g bread crumbs
- 40 g grated Grana Padano
- 1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk
- 1 dl white wine
- 0.5 onion
- 0.5 teaspoon grated lemon zest
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste flour
- to taste nutmeg
- to taste breadcrumbs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Sauté the chopped onion in the oil for 3 minutes, add the meat with the chicken livers cut into small pieces.
2. After 5 minutes, pour in the wine, let it evaporate and continue cooking for about 10 minutes, stirring often.
3. Put the meat, egg yolk, Grana Padano, bread crumbs, a pinch of nutmeg, and lemon zest in the mixer and season with salt.
4. Pit the olives with the appropriate tool and fill them with the mixture obtained, possibly using a piping bag with a small round tip.
5. Dredge the olives in the flour, then in the beaten egg, and then in the breadcrumbs.
6. Fry them in hot oil, turning them.
7. Drain them with the appropriate spatula and place them on kitchen paper towels.
